name: Drive Replay Demo
description: Scripted run (~65 s): replays a highway drive into a forward collision warning that is supervised by the launch manager. Injects a hang after 20 s and a crash after 45 s; the state manager recovers both. Logs go to DLT (239.255.42.99:3490), live data to Lichtblick via showcases/drive_replay/viz/foxglove_bridge.py
